Russia and China Veto UN Iran Sanctions Monitoring

Russia and China vetoed a US-drafted resolution that would have extended the mandate of UN experts monitoring sanctions against Iran. The vote occurred at the UN Security Council. The US had sought to continue the monitoring for another year. The resolution failed to pass, with Russia and China voting against it. The specific details of the US proposal and the reasons cited by Russia and China for their veto were not detailed in the provided coverage.
